result.summary: The page is a food delivery app home screen that is mostly well-structured. Found 3 minor-to-major layout issues related to content truncation and inconsistent styling.

issues.description: The third card in 'Fastest near you' (Trattoria Piccol...) is cut off at the right edge with truncated text, appearing partially hidden without a clear indication it's a horizontally scrollable carousel.
issues.suggestion: Add a visual affordance for horizontal scrolling (e.g., partial card peek with clear edge fade) and ensure card titles handle truncation with ellipsis consistently.

issues.description: The favorite (heart) icons are inconsistent: the Tokumaru Ramen card has an unfilled heart on a white circle, while the pizza card has a heart on a dark circle, creating visual inconsistency.
issues.suggestion: Standardize the favorite button background and icon styling across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card ('Popular right now') is cut off by the viewport/navigation bar, showing only a partial image with no visible title or details.
issues.suggestion: Ensure adequate bottom padding above the navigation bar so at least one full card or a clear partial preview is shown.
